diagram.manim_description: Plain white BG canvas, 16 units wide and 9 units high, origin top-left, y grows downward, flat 2D, 3 px INK strokes. Draw two identical food trays, one above the other. Tray 1 is a rounded rectangle (corner radius 0.3) from x 7.0 to 13.0 and y 1.7 to 3.7; tray 2 is the same rectangle from y 4.8 to 6.8. Fill both CELL_FILL with an INK outline. Each tray has two compartments: a vertical INK line at x 11.0 from the top edge to the bottom edge of the tray makes a wide left compartment (x 7.0 to 11.0) and a narrow right compartment (x 11.0 to 13.0). In the left compartment of each tray draw one cutlet as a circle of radius 0.65 filled SET_B with an INK outline, centred at x 9.0 (y 2.7 in tray 1, y 5.8 in tray 2). In the right compartment of each tray draw one rasgulla as a circle of radius 0.5 filled BG with an INK outline, centred at x 12.0 (y 2.7 in tray 1, y 5.8 in tray 2). Write INK price labels, 0.5 units high, centred above each compartment: '₹43' at (9.0, 1.35) and '₹24' at (12.0, 1.35) above tray 1, and '₹43' at (9.0, 4.4) and '₹24' at (12.0, 4.4) above tray 2. Draw a tall curly brace in ANSWER green on the left of the trays, its tip pointing left: the brace runs from y 1.7 to y 6.8, its two ends sit at x 6.8 and its tip is at (6.2, 4.25), so it spans both trays. Write the label '2 × (43 + 24)' in ANSWER green, 0.5 units high, right-aligned at x 6.0 and vertically centred at y 4.25. Draw a wide curly brace in ANSWER green under the trays, its tip pointing down: it runs from x 7.0 to x 13.0, its two ends sit at y 7.1 and its tip is at (10.0, 7.7), so it spans the full width of the trays. Write the label '2 × 43 + 2 × 24' in ANSWER green, 0.5 units high, centred at (10.0, 8.2). Nothing else is drawn.
must_not_show: the words cutlet, rasgulla, tray or the friends' names
the book's two curved arrows over the left label
photograph textures, leaf-plate pattern or shadows
accuracy_checks: exactly 2 trays, each with exactly 2 compartments, one cutlet circle and one rasgulla circle (4 food circles in all)
the label ₹43 sits above every cutlet compartment and ₹24 above every rasgulla compartment, so each price is printed twice
the left brace spans both trays and carries 2 × (43 + 24); the bottom brace spans the full tray width and carries 2 × 43 + 2 × 24
2 × (43 + 24) = 2 × 67 = 134 and 2 × 43 + 2 × 24 = 86 + 48 = 134, so both labels name the same total (the LP solution)
